verdict: Google Business profiles are active; paid channels and direct calls remain low.
narrative: This period, all measurable activity came from your three Google Business profiles — no paid advertising was running on Meta or Google Ads. Your profiles logged 179 total actions over 28 days, with directions to your locations making up the clear majority, which points to local map-based interest. Call volume, however, remains low at just 8 calls across 1,210 profile impressions, and that gap between people finding you and actually reaching out is the key issue being addressed. GBP activity rose +10.26% week over week through mid-period, though the final few days showed a dip, so next week's numbers will confirm whether that gain holds.

watch_item.issue: Call volume is critically low relative to profile impressions — fewer than 1 in 100 people who see your listings are calling.
watch_item.fix: Profile content and call-to-action elements are being reviewed this week to reduce friction between a listing view and a direct call.
